name: TC-2049: the owner's Disputes screen shows the gift card and opens it
statusMessage: RestauNax 2d680a23d (2026-11-14): a payment that is already disputed cannot load a gift card (400 paymentDisputed), and tok_createDispute disputes the charge before /purchase runs, so no card is minted. Rewrite so the card is minted before the dispute lands (e.g. a held requires_capture intent on the POS card path).
